sources.entry: Nocturnal - Menu bar app featuring darker than dark dimming, Night Shift fine tuning, and the ability to turn off TouchBar on MacBook Pro.

summary.one_liner: Nocturnal is a macOS menu bar app for fine-grained display control at night, including extra-deep dimming, Night Shift tuning, multi-monitor support, and turning off the MacBook Pro Touch Bar.
summary.what_it_does: Nocturnal runs in the macOS menu bar and adjusts display settings to reduce eye strain. Per the README, it offers "darker than dark" dimming beyond the normal brightness range, Night Shift fine tuning, and multi-monitor support. It can also turn off the Touch Bar on MacBook Pro models. Installation is available through Homebrew (a cask) or a manual download of the latest release. Building from source uses Carthage to fetch dependencies, then opening the Xcode project.
use_cases: dim screen below normal minimum brightness at night
reduce eye strain while working late
control displays on multiple monitors from the menu bar
notable: Dims the screen beyond the normal brightness floor ("darker than dark")
Can turn off the Touch Bar on MacBook Pro
caveats: Requires macOS High Sierra 10.13 or later and a Mac that supports Night Shift
Apple Silicon Macs are not currently supported
Release builds are not signed with an Apple developer account, so macOS requires a manual Open override
